active_work_item.title: Deterministic trust evaluation harness
active_work_item.depends_on: CP6-01 independently QA-passed and merged via PR #13 at 387b94a17270d3b660534f80deaa846bb818ca3f
active_work_item.reason: PM architecture reset after repeated AC4 source-grounding escalation. Do not add another lexical/topic heuristic. The current typed inferenceBasis only proves provenance-node membership, not proposition support. Builder is authorized one bounded GREEN redesign of inference grounding so every material inference carries a provider-neutral structured proposition descriptor identifying the inferred subject/field (or equivalent canonical target) and interpretation class, plus exact canonical basis evidence. Deterministic evaluation must verify that the subject/target corresponds to the cited canonical node and that the interpretation is compatible with that provenance kind. Free-form qualitative judgments such as vendor reliability/inadequacy must not become grounded merely because a canonical condition/uncertainty/warning exists. Required regressions: scheduling condition -> vendor unreliable FAIL; scheduling condition -> proposition-compatible scheduling inference PASS; unrelated uncertainty -> qualitative vendor inference FAIL; genuinely field-compatible uncertainty inference PASS. Preserve not_stated validation and all prior potential-risk, invented-charge, arithmetic, uncertainty, exclusion/allowance/condition and no-material-concern regressions. Update DATA_CONTRACTS/AI_PIPELINE/EVAL_PLAN for the structured proposition contract. If this cannot be achieved without broad product-contract churn or deterministic prose-semantic heuristics, stop and return to PM. Exact-head deterministic CI/build required. No paid/live eval or YELLOW/RED action authorized.

commercial_milestone: A stranger can upload 2-3 quotes, receive a useful preview, unlock a complete report, and receive grounded analysis without fabricated findings
